_README: Label id -> structure name for the foot bone volume from the Visible Human male frozen CT feet block (IDC series 94755b62-0f88-4aa8-82ec-2d6d5cb8dbc7, ankle to toes) by scripts/cryo/feet_from_ct.py, plus the mapping onto atlas entities.

A KEY, not data. HU>=200 bone, the distal tibia/fibula removed by proximity to the DU tibia/fibula meshes of the same body, then each foot cut by planes along its own axis from the heel: tarsals <115 mm, metatarsals 115-190 mm, phalanges beyond. Rule-based grouping, bones not separated. The feet block is registered to the legs block by their shared slice (correlation 0.968).
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), male frozen CT via the NCI Imaging Data Commons.

tarsals_right.note: Heel to 115 mm along the foot axis (calcaneus, talus, navicular, cuboid, cuneiforms unseparated).

phalanges_right.note: Beyond 190 mm along the foot axis.

tarsals_left.note: Heel to 115 mm along the foot axis (calcaneus, talus, navicular, cuboid, cuneiforms unseparated).

phalanges_left.note: Beyond 190 mm along the foot axis.
